info.name: Onelign PMS API
info.description:
Multi-tenant Agile Project Management System API

## Authentication
This API uses Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) for authentication. Include the Bearer token in the Authorization header.

## Multi-Tenancy
All API calls are automatically scoped to the user's organization based on the Azure tenant ID in the JWT token.

query.description: Organization UUID to scope the dashboard to

request.description: Returns tile-ready statistics for a SINGLE organization. Pass orgId as a query param. Requires ADMIN role.
Legacy platform-wide stats endpoint. Prefer /organizations/dashboard for dashboard tiles.

Create a new organization and pre-provision its ORG_ADMIN in one atomic transaction.

- `orgAdminEmail` is **required** — the ORG_ADMIN stub is created immediately.
- When that person first signs in via Microsoft, their account is claimed automatically and they get full ORG_ADMIN access.
- `azureTenantId` is optional but needed for Microsoft SSO login to work.

Requires ADMIN role.

response.name: 409 Conflict – Tenant Already Exists

request.description: List all organizations on the platform. Requires ADMIN role.
Get a specific organization by ID. Requires ADMIN role.
Update an organization's details. Requires ADMIN role.

Assign or replace the ORG_ADMIN for an organization using the person's EMAIL address (you don't need their UUID).

- If the user has already logged in → they are promoted immediately.
- If they have NOT logged in yet → a placeholder account is pre-created with ORG_ADMIN role. When they first sign in via Microsoft, the account is claimed automatically.

The previous ORG_ADMIN (if any) is demoted to MEMBER. Requires ADMIN role.

response.name: 200 OK – ORG_ADMIN Pre-created (user not yet logged in)
